column1: # posts-mutations.tsv —— the planted bugs of posts-tests.md § "Mutation check", as data.
# Columns (TAB-separated): id · file glob (repo-relative) · perl -0777 substitution · the commands
# that must each go red, separated by ";;". A row whose substitution changes nothing is a FAILED
# row, never a skipped one: the code it targeted moved, and the row must be pointed at the new line.
# The file/substitution columns bind to the implementation's names (backend/internal/corpus/posts:
# canSee, VisibleTo, the index filter, the event payload, …). They were written with the tests, before
# the code; when the implementation lands, each row is pointed at the real line it breaks.

column4: make test-only SPEC=posts-visibility;;make test-only SPEC=posts-no-side-channel;;make test-only SPEC=posts-paging
